name: DSW — Digital Science Workstation
description: A native host that runs C++/HTML experiment plugins: drop a bundle in a folder and it appears in the launcher. The browser is the GUI, the heavy math runs native. Ships with Gray–Scott, a double-slit wave tank, an EBL pattern-transfer process simulator and a graphene molecular-dynamics sandbox.
note: Native desktop app — download a build for Windows, macOS or Linux, or compile it yourself; the experiments then run in your browser.
